projects.title: STORIQ
projects.problem: We needed a way to dynamically showcase projects with a modern aesthetic, maintaining accessibility without sacrificing performance.
projects.solution: Developed a custom Astro layout using Tailwind CSS, incorporating responsive grid designs and modular components for easy CMS management.
projects.impact: Increased user engagement and provided a seamless editing experience through Decap CMS.

projects.title: erni
projects.problem: Managing multiple business financial records manually was prone to human calculation errors, delayed reporting, and lacked visual cash flow insights.
projects.solution: Engineered an intuitive, responsive web application featuring automated journal entries, instant financial statement generation, and visual analytics.
projects.impact: Reduced bookkeeping turnaround time by 65% and eliminated ledger discrepancy for active business operations.
